Fano interference requires a discrete state embedded in a CONTINUUM -- the continuum provides the smooth background against which the discrete state creates an asymmetric line shape. This is the fundamental difference between a Feshbach resonance (discrete + continuum) and a coupled doorway (discrete + discrete).
